scope: Search and share metadata only; existing card summaries and bodies are unchanged

inventory-reconciliation.zh-CN: 从单据、库存和流水的核对入手，结合库存与扫码项目，判断哪一步值得先改。
inventory-reconciliation.en: Use inventory and barcode projects to examine records, stock movements and corrections, then choose one step to improve.

enterprise-knowledge-base.zh-CN: 结合品牌客服协作经历，讲清资料怎么整理、回答如何查来源，以及何时交回人工。
enterprise-knowledge-base.en: Draw on a customer-support project to organize documents, check answer sources and define when a person must take over.

what-is-ai.zh-CN: AI 是人工智能的简称，涵盖识别、预测、生成等多种技术，既有基于规则的办法，也有从数据学习的办法。
what-is-ai.en: AI stands for artificial intelligence and includes recognition, prediction and generation, using approaches such as rules or learning from data.

ai-chat-vs-search.zh-CN: 分清 AI 聊天与搜索引擎的用途，用软件支持哪些系统的问题练习查官网、看资料日期，并核对回答是否有原始来源。
ai-chat-vs-search.en: Compare AI chat with search using a question about supported operating systems. Check the official source, its date and what the answer actually supports.

first-ai-task.zh-CN: 选一个小、可检查、做错也容易恢复的任务，比如把个人笔记改成待办清单。
first-ai-task.en: Choose something small, checkable and reversible, such as turning personal notes into tasks.

choose-ai-tool.zh-CN: 新手选 AI 工具，先用同一份练习文本比较结果与修改成本，再核对价格、数据规则和退出方式，避免只看榜单买会员。
choose-ai-tool.en: Choose an AI tool by testing the same text in two tools. Compare errors and correction effort, then check pricing, data terms and exit options.

ai-hallucination.zh-CN: AI 可能生成看似真实却没有依据的内容，常被叫作“幻觉”。
ai-hallucination.en: An AI hallucination is plausible content without adequate grounding.

ai-privacy-basics.zh-CN: 哪些资料不该直接上传给 AI？从虚构文本练习区分必要字段与个人标识，并核对组织的数据规则，不拿真实客户文件试功能。
ai-privacy-basics.en: Decide what not to upload to AI. Use fictional text to identify necessary fields and private identifiers, then check your organization's data rules.

ai-file-reading.zh-CN: 上传成功不等于 AI 读完文件。用三页各带不同标记的练习文档检查漏读，再处理扫描页、复杂表格和长附件的读取限制。
ai-file-reading.en: Check whether AI read a whole file with a different marker on each of three practice pages. Identify omissions before trusting a document summary.

ai-generated-images.zh-CN: AI 图片可以帮助讨论构图和风格，但可能改变产品尺寸、接口、文字和材质。
ai-generated-images.en: Generated images can help discuss composition and style, but may alter dimensions, ports, text or materials.

ai-jargon-map.zh-CN: 用日常说法区分 LLM、Token、上下文、Prompt、RAG、Agent、Skill、MCP、Harness 和 API，再练习把概念与具体产品名分开。
ai-jargon-map.en: Learn ten AI terms in plain language, including LLM, RAG, agents, skills, MCP and harnesses. Separate what a concept means from a product name.

ai-learning-plan.zh-CN: 零基础学 AI 的一周练习安排：整理笔记、比较提问方式、核对原始来源，再复做一项任务，记录能重复使用的步骤。
ai-learning-plan.en: Plan a beginner's first week with AI: organize notes, compare prompts, verify a fact and repeat one task to build a reusable procedure.

what-is-llm.zh-CN: 用浅显例子区分大语言模型与聊天软件，了解文件和联网能力为何取决于具体产品，并检查回答是否有依据。
what-is-llm.en: Understand what an LLM is and how it differs from a chat app. Separate the language model from the interface, file tools and other product features.

how-llm-generates.zh-CN: 语言模型根据上下文逐步生成后续的文字单位，而不是从一个固定答案库复制整段结论。
how-llm-generates.en: A language model generates successive text units conditioned on context rather than copying a complete fixed answer.

what-is-token.zh-CN: Token 是模型处理文字的单位，可能对应字、词的一部分或其他片段。
what-is-token.en: A token is a unit used to process text: a character, part of a word or another segment.

context-window.zh-CN: AI 为什么聊久了会忘事？理解上下文窗口的容量限制，练习用一页摘要保留目标、限制和已确认事实，再开启下一项任务。
context-window.en: Understand why long AI conversations lose context. Make a one-page brief of goals, constraints and confirmed facts before starting a new task.

training-vs-inference.zh-CN: 训练会调整模型参数，推理是用已有模型处理当前输入。
training-vs-inference.en: Training changes model parameters; inference uses a model on current input.

neural-network-basics.zh-CN: 神经网络用多层计算把输入变成输出，训练时调整其中的参数。
neural-network-basics.en: A neural network maps inputs to outputs through layers of computation with adjustable parameters.

embeddings-explained.zh-CN: Embedding 把内容表示成一组数字，用于比较某种相似性。
embeddings-explained.en: An embedding represents content numerically for similarity comparisons.

rag-explained.zh-CN: RAG 是先检索相关资料，再把找到的内容交给模型回答。
rag-explained.en: RAG retrieves relevant information before generating an answer from it.

fine-tuning-or-rag.zh-CN: 提示词、RAG 知识库与微调怎么选？先写清一项可测试的失败，补足指令和资料，再判断是否值得投入训练与评测。
fine-tuning-or-rag.en: Choose between prompting, RAG and fine-tuning by identifying one testable failure. Try clearer instructions and suitable sources before considering training.

model-size-and-cost.zh-CN: 选大模型不只看参数和单次价格。用相同输入比较正常、缺资料与边界情况，连同人工修正时间一起判断模型是否够用。
model-size-and-cost.en: Compare AI models on the same normal, incomplete and edge-case tasks. Include human correction effort when deciding whether a model is good enough.

prompt-basics.zh-CN: Prompt 是给 AI 的指令与相关信息。通过一项小任务练习说清输入、目标和输出要求，再检查回答是否符合原来的需求。
prompt-basics.en: Learn what a prompt contains and practice explaining one small task. State the input, goal and expected output, then check the result against the request.

provide-context.zh-CN: 只给影响判断的背景：谁在用、现在怎么做、卡在哪里、希望得到什么。
provide-context.en: Provide background that changes the decision: who uses the result, the current process, the blockage and the desired outcome.

prompt-with-example.zh-CN: 用一组输入和理想输出教 AI 按格式整理信息，再加一个缺日期的样例示范留空，最后换新材料检查是否真正理解规则。
prompt-with-example.en: Guide AI with an input and desired output, plus an example with a missing date. Test new material to check that the format works beyond the example.

structured-ai-output.zh-CN: 让 AI 输出固定字段或表格，先定字段顺序、允许值、金额币种与缺失处理，再用缺信息样本检查它会不会擅自补写。
structured-ai-output.en: Get structured AI output by defining fields, allowed values, currencies and missing-data rules. Test an incomplete sample for invented values.

break-down-task.zh-CN: 把长任务按可检查的中间结果拆开：先读资料，再列问题，再写草稿，最后核对。
break-down-task.en: Split work into checkable stages: read, identify questions, draft and verify.

ask-clarifying-questions.zh-CN: 让 AI 先问关键问题，又不一直等你回答：分清必要信息与可默认信息，限定首轮问题，并先完成不依赖答案的部分。
ask-clarifying-questions.en: Have AI ask useful clarifying questions without stalling. Separate essential facts from defaults and let independent work proceed while answers are pending.

rewrite-with-ai.zh-CN: 用 AI 改文案时，先锁定事实、数字与承诺，只调整表达；通过对照原稿检查是否增添了原文没有的意思。
rewrite-with-ai.en: Rewrite with AI while preserving meaning. Fix the facts and commitments first, then compare the draft with the original for unsupported additions.

ai-compare-options.zh-CN: 让 AI 比较方案，先选与你任务有关的标准并逐项附来源；只比较已验证事实，未知项列测试办法，不让模型凭空打分。
ai-compare-options.en: Compare options with AI using task-specific criteria and supporting sources. Keep unknowns explicit and propose checks instead of inventing scores.

fix-bad-ai-answer.zh-CN: 指出哪句话错、错在什么、正确规则是什么，比说“重写”更有用。
fix-bad-ai-answer.en: Identify the wrong passage, the reason and the correct rule.

save-prompt-template.zh-CN: 把好用的 AI 提问保存成模板：用占位符替换具体信息，附正常与缺信息样例，再记录修改日期和适用范围。
save-prompt-template.en: Turn an AI prompt into a reusable template with placeholders, normal and incomplete examples, a revision date and a clear intended scope.

what-is-agent.zh-CN: Agent 通常指能结合工具、反馈和多步行动推进目标的系统。
what-is-agent.en: An agent combines a model with tools, feedback and multiple actions toward a goal.

agent-first-task.zh-CN: 从能回退的小任务开始，比如在练习目录生成一份文件清单。
agent-first-task.en: Start with a reversible task such as creating an inventory in a practice directory.

agent-tools-permissions.zh-CN: Agent 要读文件、写文件或发消息时，如何判断该给哪些权限？列出任务必需范围，先从只读或单目录开始，再核对新增请求。
agent-tools-permissions.en: Decide which permissions an AI agent needs. Separate file reading, writes and external actions, and start with read-only or single-folder access.

agent-plan-and-act.zh-CN: Agent 写了计划不等于完成任务。练习设定可观察的完成标准，要求产物位置和检查记录，并亲自打开关键结果核对。
agent-plan-and-act.en: Tell an agent's plan from completed work. Set an observable acceptance criterion, request the artifact and check record, then open the result yourself.

agent-workflow-difference.zh-CN: 固定工作流按预定步骤走，Agent 可以根据反馈选择下一步。
agent-workflow-difference.en: A workflow follows predefined steps; an agent can choose steps based on feedback.

agent-feedback-loop.zh-CN: 理解 Agent 的行动与检查循环，用生成练习表格的任务核对表头、行数和关键值，发现问题先修正，再继续下一步。
agent-feedback-loop.en: Learn an agent's feedback loop by checking a generated practice table. Verify headings, row counts and key values before proceeding.

agent-memory.zh-CN: Agent 的记忆不能替代业务记录。练习把当前规则写进有生效日期的文件，并用一条旧规则检查它如何处理冲突。
agent-memory.en: Keep critical agent rules in an inspectable, dated file. Test a conflicting old rule to check that remembered information does not override current instructions.

agent-stop-rules.zh-CN: 防止 Agent 无休止重试，先约定文件范围、重试次数、预算和交还人工的条件，遇到收费或提交结果不明时保留进度。
agent-stop-rules.en: Set agent scope, retry limits, budget and handoff conditions before work starts. Preserve progress when charges or uncertain submissions require a stop.

multi-agent-basics.zh-CN: 多 Agent 是分工，不是自动更可靠。用资料检查与文字编辑的例子分清输入、产物和合并责任，避免多个角色同改一个文件。
multi-agent-basics.en: Understand multi-agent work through separate source-checking and editing roles. Define outputs and one merger rather than sharing the same file.

agent-risk-checklist.zh-CN: 老板让 Agent 处理工作前，检查访问范围、写入动作、人工确认和恢复办法；用只读试点测试正常、缺资料和失败三种情况。
agent-risk-checklist.en: Check agent access, changes, human review and recovery before business use. Start with a read-only pilot covering normal, incomplete and failed cases.

what-is-skill.zh-CN: Skill 通常是一包任务说明及可选资源，帮助兼容的 Agent 按某种办法做事。
what-is-skill.en: A skill packages task instructions and optional resources for a compatible agent.

skill-file-structure.zh-CN: 在 Agent Skills 格式中，SKILL.md 承载元信息和任务指令，旁边可放脚本、参考材料与资源。
skill-file-structure.en: In the Agent Skills format, SKILL.md contains metadata and instructions, with optional scripts, references and assets alongside it.

skill-vs-prompt.zh-CN: 偶尔做一次用提示词模板，反复做且需配套资源时再考虑 Skill。先记录稳定步骤和例外，判断封装技能是否值得。
skill-vs-prompt.en: Choose a prompt template for occasional tasks or a skill for repeatable procedures with resources. Record stable steps and exceptions before packaging.

skill-install-safely.zh-CN: 安装 Skill 前先查发布者、版本、脚本、依赖和数据去向，再用无敏感资料的练习目录小范围试跑，不按下载量判断安全。
skill-install-safely.en: Review a skill's publisher, version, scripts, dependencies and data destinations before installation. Test practice input with limited access first.

create-first-skill.zh-CN: 把会议纪要要求写成纯文字 Skill，规定输出栏目和原文定位，再换一份记录复测，检查它会不会擅自确定负责人。
create-first-skill.en: Make a text-only meeting-notes skill with output sections and source locations. Retest different notes for invented decisions or responsibilities.

what-is-mcp.zh-CN: MCP 是让 AI 应用与外部数据、工具交互的一种开放协议。
what-is-mcp.en: MCP is an open protocol for connecting AI applications to external data and tools.

mcp-vs-api.zh-CN: MCP 连上后为什么仍会查询失败？画清 AI 应用、连接服务与业务系统的关系，分开检查账号、额度、费用和失败环节。
mcp-vs-api.en: Understand MCP versus an API by mapping the AI app, connector and business system. Separate account access, quotas, costs and the failing layer.

mcp-read-only.zh-CN: 只读试点能先验证找不找得到正确资料，而不碰业务记录。
mcp-read-only.en: A read-only pilot tests whether the right information can be found without changing business records.

skill-not-working.zh-CN: Skill 装好却没生效，先分清安装、启用、任务匹配和执行。用最小任务检查未加载、缺工具或缺权限，不反复安装同一包。
skill-not-working.en: Troubleshoot a skill that is installed but inactive. Use a minimal matching task to separate loading, tool and permission failures before reinstalling.

prompt-injection-basics.zh-CN: 外部网页、文档或技能可能夹带“忽略原要求”等指令，诱使 Agent 越权。
prompt-injection-basics.en: External pages, files or skills can contain instructions intended to override the task.

what-is-harness.zh-CN: Harness 在 Agent 讨论里通常指让模型可靠工作的一套运行配套，例如工具、状态记录、权限和检查。
what-is-harness.en: In agent discussions, a harness is the surrounding execution setup: tools, state, permissions and checks.

ai-coding-basics.zh-CN: 不会编程也可从去空行等本地小工具练起。让 AI 先解释实现和改动文件，再测试普通、空白及异常输入，不把生成代码当验收。
ai-coding-basics.en: Start AI coding with a small offline tool, such as removing blank lines. Review affected files and test normal, empty and unusual inputs.

read-ai-code-plan.zh-CN: 外行审查 AI 改代码的计划，先说清当前问题与期望行为，再核对拟改文件、不改范围和验证办法，不必先学完全部语法。
read-ai-code-plan.en: Review an AI code-change plan without knowing every syntax detail. Check the defect, intended behavior, affected files, exclusions and validation steps.

terminal-basics.zh-CN: 终端用文字命令操作程序。新手先练查看目录和文件列表，并逐段理解 AI 提供的命令，单独审查删除、管理员权限和下载脚本。
terminal-basics.en: Learn terminal commands through directory and file-listing tasks. Read proposed commands part by part before considering deletion or elevated access.

what-is-local-preview.zh-CN: 分清本地预览与正式上线：记录两种地址，在本地检查关键流程和手机宽度，发布后再确认公开网站的实际版本。
what-is-local-preview.en: Separate local preview from a public release. Test core flows and phone-width layouts locally, then verify the public revision after deployment.

acceptance-tests.zh-CN: 验收测试检查需求是否满足，而不是只看“构建（把源码转换为可运行或可发布的文件）通过”。
acceptance-tests.en: Acceptance tests check requirements rather than only a successful build (turning source into runnable or publishable files).

ai-debugging.zh-CN: 让 AI 修 Bug，先记复现步骤、期望与实际结果，再验证一个原因、做最小修改，最后复查原问题和相邻功能。
ai-debugging.en: Debug with AI by recording reproduction steps and testing one likely cause. Make a minimal fix, then retest the original issue and nearby behavior.

ai-checkpoints.zh-CN: 检查点帮助下一次继续：当前目标、已完成、未完成、文件位置、关键限制和下一步。
ai-checkpoints.en: A checkpoint records the goal, completed and pending work, file locations, constraints and next action.

dependency-basics.zh-CN: 理解软件依赖为什么会带来更多文件。安装前问清要补哪个能力，比较现有办法，并保留锁定版本和安装记录。
dependency-basics.en: Understand software dependencies before installing a package. Check the missing capability, consider existing tools and retain version locks and install records.

coding-without-secrets.zh-CN: API Key 是访问服务的凭证，不是普通配置示例。
coding-without-secrets.en: An API key is a credential, not an ordinary example value.

what-is-github.zh-CN: GitHub 是围绕代码和项目协作的平台，也能阅读文档、报告问题和查看版本。
what-is-github.en: GitHub hosts code and project collaboration, including documentation, issues and versions.

repository-basics.zh-CN: 仓库保存项目文件及版本历史，便于查看谁在什么时候改了什么。
repository-basics.en: A repository holds project files and revision history.

readme-basics.zh-CN: 看不懂 GitHub 项目的 README？先找用途、系统要求、启动前提、操作步骤和许可证，并确认文档对应当前版本。
readme-basics.en: Read a GitHub README by finding its purpose, supported systems, prerequisites, steps and license. Check that the instructions match the project version.

download-release-or-source.zh-CN: 分清 GitHub 源码 ZIP 与可运行的 Release 附件，从项目说明找到官方发布入口，再核对平台支持和可用校验值。
download-release-or-source.en: Tell a GitHub source ZIP from a release asset. Use the official release entry, check platform support and verify publisher checksums when provided.

commit-basics.zh-CN: 保存改变当前文件，Commit 则把一组变更记入版本历史并附说明。
commit-basics.en: Saving changes a file; a commit records a set of changes in history with a message.

branch-basics.zh-CN: 分支让一组修改在独立的版本线上进行，便于比较和合并。
branch-basics.en: A branch lets work proceed on a separate line of development for comparison and merging.

pull-request-basics.zh-CN: Pull Request 是提议合并一组修改并供人讨论审查的入口。
pull-request-basics.en: A pull request proposes changes for review and merging.

issue-basics.zh-CN: 好的 Issue 说明环境、复现步骤、预期、实际和相关错误。
issue-basics.en: A useful issue includes environment, reproduction, expected and actual behavior, and errors.

open-source-license.zh-CN: 开源不代表可以随意商用。先读仓库 LICENSE 与依赖说明，区分内部使用和分发，再核对原许可证要求，不能只听 AI 总结。
open-source-license.en: Check an open-source project's LICENSE and dependency notices before commercial use. Separate internal use from distribution and read the original obligations.

github-public-private.zh-CN: 公开仓库内容可被他人读取和复制；私有仓库限制访问，但也不适合把秘密凭证直接当普通文件存。
github-public-private.en: Public repositories can be read and copied; private ones restrict access but are not a reason to store secrets as ordinary files.

what-is-workbuddy.zh-CN: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 入门：认准 workbuddy.cn 官方入口，从一份练习材料开始，了解任务、文件产物与权限边界，核对结果后再用于正式工作。
what-is-workbuddy.en: Learn what Tencent WorkBuddy at workbuddy.cn does. Start with practice files, check task outputs and permissions, then decide how it fits office work.

workbuddy-first-task.zh-CN: 用 WorkBuddy 从练习 notes.txt 生成 tasks.txt：说明输入、动作、产物和限制，再从结果入口打开文件，核对有没有遗漏或补写。
workbuddy-first-task.en: Create a WorkBuddy task using practice notes.txt and a separate tasks.txt output. Specify limits, find the artifact and check it against the source.

workbuddy-file-organizing.zh-CN: 用 WorkBuddy 整理文件前，先生成旧名、新名和原因的对照表；处理重名、缺日期等情况，确认后只对练习副本执行。
workbuddy-file-organizing.en: Preview file organization in WorkBuddy with an old-to-new name mapping. Check collisions and missing dates before approving changes to practice copies.

workbuddy-meeting-notes.zh-CN: 用 WorkBuddy 整理会议文字，分清讨论、决定、待办和未定项，给待办保留原句与负责人状态，核对后再分享纪要文件。
workbuddy-meeting-notes.en: Use WorkBuddy to turn meeting text into notes. Separate decisions from discussion, retain source sentences and verify action owners before sharing.

workbuddy-spreadsheet.zh-CN: 用 WorkBuddy 看 Excel，先说明字段与行数，再列缺字段、重复编号和数量异常，人工核对后才考虑改原表或业务系统。
workbuddy-spreadsheet.en: Review an Excel practice sheet with WorkBuddy by checking fields, row counts and exceptions. Verify missing values, duplicate IDs and quantities before edits.

workbuddy-write-document.zh-CN: 让 WorkBuddy 写出可用文档，先给读者、用途、已确认事实和不许承诺的内容；先审提纲，再逐项核对日期、价格和说法。
workbuddy-write-document.en: Get a useful WorkBuddy document by defining its audience, purpose and verified facts. Review the outline and check claims before exporting a draft.

workbuddy-skills.zh-CN: 选择 WorkBuddy 技能时，先判断现有能力是否够用，再读候选技能的输入、输出、脚本和权限，只启用当前任务需要的部分。
workbuddy-skills.en: Choose WorkBuddy skills by checking the current task's capability gap. Review inputs, outputs, scripts and permissions, then test only the needed skill.

workbuddy-connectors.zh-CN: WorkBuddy 连接邮箱或文档前，先确认要读什么、能否写入或外发，以及如何撤销授权；用非敏感内容做只读验证。
workbuddy-connectors.en: Before connecting WorkBuddy to email or documents, check data scope, write and send access, and revocation options. Start with a non-sensitive read-only test.

workbuddy-permissions.zh-CN: 把提示翻译成真实动作：读哪个目录、写哪个文件、执行什么命令、是否外发。
workbuddy-permissions.en: Translate a permission prompt into concrete actions: which directory, file, command or external destination.

workbuddy-task-failed.zh-CN: WorkBuddy 卡住或没产物，先分清排队、运行、报错和等待确认，再查结果入口、工具与额度，保留错误原文，避免重复建任务。
workbuddy-task-failed.en: Troubleshoot a stalled WorkBuddy task by checking status, artifact location, tools and allowances. Keep the exact error rather than submitting duplicate tasks.

ai-email-draft.zh-CN: 用 AI 写邮件，先给目的、收件人关系与已确认事实，缺项留空；检查称呼、承诺和附件后再由本人发送，不让草稿替你做决定。
ai-email-draft.en: Draft an email with AI using a clear purpose and verified facts. Leave gaps explicit and review the recipient, commitments and attachments before sending.

ai-meeting-actions.zh-CN: 纪要不是把聊天写得正式，而是保留谁决定了什么、谁还没确认。
ai-meeting-actions.en: Minutes preserve decisions and unresolved matters rather than merely formalizing conversation.

ai-spreadsheet-cleaning.zh-CN: AI 清洗表格前，先区分编号、数量和金额，说明单位与空值规则，再对比处理前后的行数和关键合计，避免只看排版。
ai-spreadsheet-cleaning.en: Clean a spreadsheet with AI by defining IDs, quantities, amounts, units and missing values. Compare row counts and key totals before and after.

ai-inventory-exceptions.zh-CN: 用两张虚构库存表练习 AI 差异核对，按商品编号与规格匹配，保留单位、时间和原始行；先列异常，不自动改账。
ai-inventory-exceptions.en: Practice inventory reconciliation with two fictional tables. Match item IDs and specifications, retain source rows and report exceptions without adjusting stock.

ai-product-copy.zh-CN: 尺寸、材质、认证、适用范围和效果必须有依据。
ai-product-copy.en: Dimensions, materials, certifications, compatibility and results need evidence.

ai-translation-review.zh-CN: 翻译要保留数字、条件、否定和术语，不能只看语句流畅。
ai-translation-review.en: Check numbers, conditions, negation and terminology rather than fluency alone.

ai-weekly-report.zh-CN: 用 AI 写周报，先把记录标为已完成、进行中、计划或阻断，再附实际产物，检查改稿有没有把准备做的事写成成果。
ai-weekly-report.en: Write an AI-assisted weekly report by labeling completed, ongoing, planned and blocked work. Attach actual outputs and check for exaggerated results.

ai-ocr-check.zh-CN: OCR 把图片里的文字转为可处理文本，不保证数字和表格关系都正确。
ai-ocr-check.en: OCR turns image text into machine-readable text but can misread digits and table structure.

ai-knowledge-base-start.zh-CN: 先选一个部门反复问的主题，整理有效版本、负责人与适用范围。
ai-knowledge-base-start.en: Choose one recurring question area and organize current versions, owners and scope.

ai-sop-writing.zh-CN: 先访谈实际操作者，再整理步骤、前提、例外和完成标准。
ai-sop-writing.en: Interview the actual operator and document steps, prerequisites, exceptions and completion checks.

owner-ai-first-step.zh-CN: 老板想用 AI 提效，先看员工怎样完成一件真实工作，把重复动作与必要判断分开，再选低风险环节试点，不急着买系统。
owner-ai-first-step.en: Start business AI improvement by observing one real workflow. Separate repeated steps from necessary judgment and choose a low-risk pilot before buying tools.

ai-task-selection.zh-CN: 哪些工作适合先用 AI？列出五项重复任务，比较频率、出错后果与检查难度，再选一项输入稳定、容易核对的只读试点。
ai-task-selection.en: Choose a first business AI task by comparing repeated work, frequency, error consequences and review effort. Select one limited, checkable read-only pilot.

ai-pilot-design.zh-CN: 给企业 AI 小试点定清输入、周期和不做范围，保留正常、边界与失败样本，按预先约定的标准决定继续还是停止。
ai-pilot-design.en: Design a small business AI pilot with approved inputs, exclusions and a time limit. Test normal and failed cases against preset acceptance criteria.

ai-cost-breakdown.zh-CN: 费用可能包括工具、调用、配置开发、培训、审核和维护。
ai-cost-breakdown.en: Costs can include subscriptions, usage, configuration, development, training, review and maintenance.

measure-ai-benefit.zh-CN: 看完成同类任务的总时间、错误、返工和人工复核，不只看模型生成速度。
measure-ai-benefit.en: Measure total task time, errors, rework and review, not generation speed alone.

choose-ai-provider.zh-CN: 挑选企业 AI 提效服务商，先提供脱敏流程说明，让候选方按同一口径列交付、范围和报价，再核对案例证据与责任。
choose-ai-provider.en: Compare business AI service providers using one sanitized workflow brief. Request comparable scopes and quotes, then check case evidence and delivery ownership.

what-is-fde-business.zh-CN: FDE 常指 Forward Deployed Engineer，工作方式偏向贴近客户流程，把技术落到实际场景。
what-is-fde-business.en: FDE commonly means Forward Deployed Engineer, a role working close to customer workflows to implement technology.

ai-employee-training.zh-CN: 给员工做 AI 入门培训，选他们能判断对错的小任务，同时演示正确与错误样例，再安排独立练习，明确何时交给人处理。
ai-employee-training.en: Train staff on AI with a familiar, checkable task. Show useful and incorrect outputs, practice independently and make human escalation clear.

ai-maintenance-owner.zh-CN: AI 工具交付后如何维护？分别约定数据、规则、软件与账号负责人，写清更新后的复查，以及导出、备份和停用办法。
ai-maintenance-owner.en: Plan maintenance after an AI tool is delivered. Assign owners for data, rules, software and accounts, with retesting, backup and shutdown procedures.

ai-consultation-prepare.zh-CN: 企业 AI 免费初次咨询前，先说业务、现有做法和最麻烦的一步；用一个日常实例说明情况，再问清免费沟通与收费实施的边界。
ai-consultation-prepare.en: Prepare for an initial AI consultation with your business, current process and hardest step. Bring one example and clarify discussion versus implementation.
